verdict.rationale: Honcho is a memory layer, so customizing the memory schema is a fair question for it. The evidence describes only fixed primitives (workspaces, peers, sessions, representations). Modeling 'any entity' and shaping retrieval with search, token budgets and peer scoping are adjacent features, not user-defined entity types, edge types or ontologies, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can customize the memory schema — entity types, edge types, or ontology — to match my domain
